title: Storing and Using Stream Data (BLOBs and CLOBs) | Using SQL | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: CREATE TABLE Sample.MyTable ( Name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, Notes LONGVARCHAR, Photo LONGVARBINARY)
INSERT INTO Sample.MyTable (Name,Notes) VALUES ('Fred','These are extensive notes about Fred')
SELECT Name,Photo,Notes FROM Sample.MyTable WHERE Photo IS NOT NULL
SELECT Name,Notes FROM Sample.MyTable WHERE Notes IS NOT NULL
SELECT Name,Notes FROM Sample.MyTable WHERE Notes %MATCHES '*1[0-9]*GlobalChar*'
SELECT COUNT(Photo) AS PicRows,COUNT(Notes) AS NoteRows FROM Sample.MyTable
SELECT Name,DATALENGTH(Notes) AS NotesNumChars FROM Sample.MyTable WHERE Notes IS NOT NULL
SELECT Name,SUBSTRING(Notes,1,10) AS Notes1st10Chars FROM Sample.MyTable WHERE Notes IS NOT NULL
SELECT Name,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),Notes) AS NotesTextAsStr FROM Sample.MyTable WHERE Notes IS NOT NULL
SELECT Name,Notes,%OBJECT(Notes) AS NotesOref FROM Sample.MyTable WHERE Notes IS NOT NULL
